threshold_rule: maximise validation recall subject to validation precision >= 0.95; ties -> highest threshold
input_scaling: uint8 / 255 -> float32 in [0, 1] (the model rescales to [-1, 1] internally)
provenance: float16 TFLite model exported from the executed notebook (notebooks/Driver_Drowsiness_Detection.ipynb); threshold 0.14 was chosen on the validation set
